title: Seed aging
text: seeds age, germination first slows viability stays nearly constant. Viability declines along sigmoid curve. Seeds lot range potential lifetimes follow normal distribution (Ellis Roberts, 1981). Bradford et al. (1993) used increasing germination delays predict decline threshold model: θA=(pmax(g)−p)tg\theta_A = (p_{max}(g) - p)\, t_g pp aging (storage) period, pmax(g)p_{max}(g) maximum lifetime seed fraction g, normally distributed median pmax(50)p_{max}(50) standard deviation σ\sigma, θA\theta_A aging time constant. Germination falls aging period approaches seed’s lifetime, fitted model uses upper tail distribution: g=1−Φ(p+θA/tg−pmax(50)σ)g = 1 - \Phi\left(\frac{p + \theta_A / t_g - p_{max}(50)}{\sigma}\right)
